SELECT 
    (SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) * 100.0 / 229474.7) as percentage
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
  AND c.parent_id = 1;

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) / 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN orders.id ELSE NULL END) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders 
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

args.sql:
SELECT 
    c.id AS category_id,
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS gross_profit
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1
